title: Document Archive
subtitle: Official rulings, procedural records and expert assessments.

documents.title: Ruling — Moscow Region Arbitration Court
documents.desc: The court finds: the land sale by JSC FEZ is entirely lawful, no loss was incurred, and the sale price exceeded the cadastral value.

documents.title: Interpol CCF — Complaint Accepted for Review
documents.desc: The Interpol Commission for the Control of Files (CCF) confirms it has opened a review of the Red Notice (ref. CCF/135/R1610.25). The defence has one month to submit any additional materials.

documents.title: Search and Seizure Record — LLC Company for Valuation and Law
documents.desc: Record of the investigative search of 15 December 2022, compiled by Investigator Yu. M. Salikov. Documents the seizure of CRM system data — files relating to transactions 2021/447 and 2021/3327.

documents.title: Inspection Record
documents.desc: Inspection of the optical disc containing the CRM database of LLC Company for Valuation and Law. Key findings: the appraisal firm was located through an ordinary internet search; the contract was signed by General Director A. V. Panov. The record contains correspondence that directly contradicts the prosecution's conspiracy theory.

documents.title: Inspection Record — Witness Sorokina's Phone
documents.desc: Inspection of the hard drive and iPhone 12 of witness I. O. Sorokina, an appraiser at LLC Company for Valuation and Law. Compiled by investigation team leader Yu. M. Salikov. Contains WhatsApp messages between the appraisal firm's staff, recorded by the investigation as evidence.

documents.title: Page-by-Page Analysis of the Charges — Defence Objections
documents.desc: A systematic examination of the charge sheet, page by page, with the defence's detailed objections to each section.

documents.title: Evidence Turned Upside Down: Three Episodes of Inverted Interpretation
documents.desc: The investigators quote their own records accurately — and reach conclusions that are the direct opposite of the plain meaning of the words on the page. Episode 1: 'the value must be real' is read as proof of a conspiracy to suppress value. Episode 2: a trip to collect an original report — explained by the very CRM correspondence cited — is declared 'illogical' and evidence of criminal intent. Episode 3: 'sent in pdf', a routine work message, is placed in the conspiracy evidence file.
